title: A back at the mailbox
logline: The mailbox in December with a man in plaid at it from behind, the door open, his hand inside, and nothing in the hand when it comes out. The page that draws the checking, two days before the first flag.

panels.composition: A man in blue plaid from behind at a roadside mailbox with its door open, his hand inside it, rain, a porch light far back.

characters.pose: from behind, hand in the box

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a man in blue plaid flannel seen from behind at a roadside mailbox with its door open and his hand inside, rain and a distant porch light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
